You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Senior Administrator
Company: Old Mutual
About the company: Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this.
Purpose of the role: This role provides immediate response to administrative requirements in accordance with SLA parameters, in a processing environment. The incumbent is individually accountable for achieving results through own efforts.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Follows standardised processes and provides administrative support in line with normal business functioning.
  - Delivers on daily production standards and adheres to service and quality standards.
  - Provides an indirect service to customers and intermediates.
  - Responds to immediate requirements within procedure.
  - Uses standard administrative techniques to co ordinate own work.
  - Product and process knowledge in different areas may differ but basic skills remain the same.
  - Partially multi skilled across product and process relevant to the business area.
  - Ensure exceptions processing for Stop Order Premium Collections Processes for RMM/PF and for both Legacy and OMP Products.
  - Statistical reporting.
  - Be able to multi function across the bigger team for additional administrative functions Legacy and OMP/GL.
  - Control Accounts (DD220, YPU, YUP,U9999, misdirected, Suspense C (Dummy Balancing)/Unallocated Statement Tray
  - Attend to queries and escalations (Workflow/emails)
  - Refunds
  - Process documenting and maintenance
  - Testing
  - Prepare moderately complex documents using a variety of applications for technology devices, such as standard office software.
  - Responsible for gathering and summarizing data for reports.
  - Produce accurate reports for others by collecting data from a variety of standard sources and inputting it into standard formats.
  - Extract and combine data to generate standard reports.
  - Develop working knowledge of the organization's policies and procedures and of regulatory codes and codes of conduct relevant to own work, adhering to mandatory procedures to ensure own work is undertaken to the required standards.
  - Ensure exceptions processing for all Stop Order Premium Collections Processes for RMM/PF and for both Legacy and OMP Products.
Must-have requirements:
  - Moderate (intermediate) to high level of technical knowledge.
  - Strong administrative skills and good relationship building and be able to engage with internal as well as external stakeholders.
  - MS Excel (Intermediate to advance)
  - Matriculation Certificate (Matric) (Required)
Nice-to-have:
  - System knowledge advantage Omunet/OMP/BANCS and Hyphen
Location: Pinelands
Closing date: 2026-11-05
Employment equity statement: The appointment will be made from the designated group in line with the Employment Equity Plan of Old Mutual South Africa and the specific business unit in question.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Senior Administrator

Old Mutual

Pinelands

About us
Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this.

About the role
You will respond to administrative requirements within SLA parameters in a processing environment. You are individually accountable for achieving results through your own efforts, working to daily production, service and quality standards.

What you'll do
• Process exceptions for all Stop Order Premium Collections processes for RMM/PF, across both Legacy and OMP products.
• Work control accounts including DD220, YPU, YUP, U9999, misdirected items, Suspense C (dummy balancing) and the unallocated statement tray.
• Attend to queries and escalations received through workflow and email.
• Process refunds in line with set procedures.
• Document and maintain processes, and carry out testing.
• Gather, extract and combine data from standard sources to produce accurate statistical and standard reports for others.
• Prepare moderately complex documents using standard office software.
• Follow standardised processes to provide administrative support in line with normal business functioning, and meet daily production standards.
• Provide an indirect service to customers and intermediaries, responding to immediate requirements within procedure.
• Multi-function across the wider team on additional administrative work for Legacy and OMP/GL.
• Build working knowledge of organisational policies, procedures, regulatory codes and codes of conduct relevant to your work, and adhere to mandatory procedures.

What you need
• Matriculation Certificate (Matric)
• Moderate (intermediate) to high level of technical knowledge
• Intermediate to advanced MS Excel, needed to extract, combine and report on data
• Strong administrative skills, with the ability to build relationships and engage with internal and external stakeholders

Nice to have
• System knowledge of Omunet, OMP, BANCS and Hyphen
• Multi-skilling across products and processes relevant to the business area

Closing date: 2026-11-05

The appointment will be made from the designated group in line with the Employment Equity Plan of Old Mutual South Africa and the specific business unit in question.
